findings.title: Direction precedence contradicts the required tightening behavior
findings.description: T7 lists `n < floor → INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE` before the `TIGHTEN` check, so a below-floor, low-match-rate cell will return `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE` and never reach `TIGHTEN`. That conflicts with T7’s prose and success criteria, T8’s regression test, and the slice requirement that tightening is not floor-gated. Reorder or otherwise specify the checks so the implementation instructions and expected behavior agree.

findings.title: Runtime-drawn-model limitation is not required in recommendation output
findings.description: T9 requires a note that the recommendation applies to a template/model pairing and that model and threshold are chosen together at config time. The slice design additionally requires the note to explain that, for a step using a runtime-drawn model, the threshold cannot track the drawn model and the recommendation does not apply to that step. T9 does not require that limitation to appear, leaving a stated success criterion uncovered.

findings.title: Commit markers are placed after every task, including untested work
findings.description: The file has a `**Commit**:` marker after each of T1–T17. In particular, T1’s marker comes before its regression tests in T2, so it marks an untested point; the repeated markers also conflict with the requirement to place them at tested working points rather than after every task. Consolidate markers at tested milestones, such as after implementation-and-test pairs. The no-mutation byte-snapshot assertion is also repeated in T10 and T16; keep the necessary coverage, but remove one redundant automated snapshot check.
